subject.title: Feature Request: Masked Secrets - Prevent Agent from Accessing Raw API Keys

question: Should OpenClaw add a native credential boundary for agent-executed commands, and should that boundary be a core SecretRef extension, a credential-provider/proxy plugin API, or an external/plugin-only pattern?
rationale: The current implementation provides partial hardening and plugin mitigations, but the requested behavior would define a new security boundary and config/API contract that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Design native boundary
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask secops/product to define the core or SDK credential-provider boundary before implementation.

options.title: External/plugin-only path
options.body: Document the existing hook/plugin and OS-isolation mitigations as the supported path and close only after a maintainer explicitly rejects core native masking.

options.title: Narrow placeholder safety net
options.body: Implement a limited `{{secret}}` substitution and redaction layer while clearly documenting that it is not a security boundary.

recommendation.title: Design native boundary
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask secops/product to define the core or SDK credential-provider boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS routes the implicated secrets, auth, config, gateway, agent, and security-doc surfaces to this team.
